sentences.en: And then we started to wait.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始等待。

sentences.zh: 他一开始迟到了15分钟，然后20分钟，然后30分钟。

sentences.en: About an hour now, it's gone by.
sentences.zh: 大约一个小时过去了。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在，在某个时刻，我差点放弃了。

sentences.en: I thought, this is it.
sentences.zh: 我想，就是这样了。

sentences.en: You know, we've basically just thrown away a plane ticket to Canada.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们基本上是把一张去加拿大的机票给白白浪费了。

sentences.en: And at some point, I remember that you, that you turned around to ask me, do you think there's any chance that this person is dangerous?
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，我记得你，你转过身来问我，你觉得这个人有任何危险的可能吗？

sentences.zh: 对，我问你有没有害怕过。

sentences.zh: 你还记得你做了什么吗？

sentences.zh: 我发生了这件非常尴尬的事。

sentences.zh: 然后你给我讲了一个故事，我想，你现在能讲讲那个故事吗？

sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.zh: 所以，我通常不容易被吓到。

sentences.en: But in 2015, I got a phone call from the FBI.
sentences.zh: 但在2015年，我接到了联邦调查局的一个电话。

sentences.en: Are you Mr. Khamenei Kalimaki?
sentences.zh: 请问是卡梅内·卡利马奇先生吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是。

sentences.en: May I come to see you right now?
sentences.zh: 我现在可以来见你吗？

sentences.en: I can be at your office in the next 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我可以在接下来的20分钟内到达你的办公室。

sentences.en: And we went into a conference room, not far from here.
sentences.zh: 然后我们走进了一个离这不远的会议室。

sentences.en: And the agent read a prepared statement.
sentences.zh: 特工宣读了一份准备好的声明。

sentences.en: He said, you are the subject of a targeted threat from the Islamic State, and we can't tell you more.
sentences.zh: 他说，你是伊斯兰国定向威胁的目标，我们不能告诉你更多。

sentences.en: That was the first serious threat.
sentences.zh: 那是第一个严重的威胁。

sentences.en: But it started to percolate, you know, somewhere, that they were noticing what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 但它开始在某个地方发酵，你知道的，他们注意到了我在做的事情。

sentences.en: Since then, I've seen how I've become a presence in their online chat rooMs.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我发现自己是如何成为他们在线聊天室里的一个常驻人物的。

sentences.en: They talk about my reporting.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论我的报道。

sentences.en: They dissect my tweets.
sentences.zh: 他们剖析我的推文。

sentences.en: They sometimes insult me.
sentences.zh: 他们有时会侮辱我。

sentences.en: And these insults, if I can just say so, sometimes are pretty funny.
sentences.zh: 如果我可以直言的话，这些侮辱有时还挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: I think they've figured out that I'm sensitive about my weight.
sentences.zh: 我想他们已经发现我对自己的体重很敏感。

sentences.en: So they sometimes call me oinkmini instead of rukmini.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有时不叫我鲁克米尼，而是叫我“小猪米尼”（oinkmini）。

sentences.en: It's oinkmini like pig.
sentences.zh: 就是像猪一样的 oinkmini。

sentences.en: Fat mochi.
sentences.zh: 胖麻薯。

sentences.en: Oinkmini, fat mochi.
sentences.zh: 小猪米尼，胖麻薯。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to laugh.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉笑出来。

sentences.en: I mean, there's something ironic about being fat shamed by ISIS, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，被伊斯兰国进行身材羞辱，这本身就有点讽刺，你知道的。

sentences.en: So, you know, they'll make jabs about how I've put on a couple of pounds based on my latest, you know, TV appearance.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，他们会根据我最新的，你知道的，电视亮相，冷嘲热讽说我又胖了几磅。

sentences.en: But then sometimes what they say is dead serious.
sentences.zh: 但有时他们说的话又是无比严肃的。

sentences.en: So, for example, when I was in Mosul a couple of months ago, they started talking about how they were hoping that I would get killed in Mosul,
sentences.zh: 所以，比如说，几个月前我在摩苏尔时，他们开始讨论说他们希望我在摩苏尔被杀，

sentences.en: just like the Kurdish journalist who was killed there at the same time in the city.
sentences.zh: 就像那个同时在城里被杀的库尔德记者一样。

sentences.en: But then let's see, what are the others?
sentences.zh: 但接下来，还有什么呢？

sentences.en: Do you have like a folder on your phone where you keep the threats?
sentences.zh: 你的手机里是不是有一个文件夹，专门保存那些威胁？

sentences.en: Is that what I'm looking at here?
sentences.zh: 我在这里看到的就是那个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: One of them is a masked man who was holding up a knife that he's pointing towards the camera.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是蒙面男子，手里拿着一把刀，正指着镜头。

sentences.en: And he said, under a picture of me, wanted to be kill this crusader woman that refuses to join to Islam, Rukmini Kalimaki.
sentences.zh: 在一张我的照片下面，他说，通缉杀死这个拒绝加入伊斯兰教的十字军女人，鲁克米尼·卡利马奇。

sentences.en: Please join to religion before beheading or truck from our soldiers of Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 请在被伊斯兰国士兵斩首或用卡车撞击之前皈依宗教。

sentences.en: Okay, pretty explicit.
sentences.zh: 好吧，相当露骨。

sentences.en: So they created a channel where they're pretending to be me, and then they're pretending to post in this channel as me.
sentences.zh: 所以他们创建了一个频道，假装是我，然后在这个频道里以我的名义发帖。

sentences.en: And it says, I have to confess something here.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，我在这里必须坦白一件事。

sentences.en: I started covering ISIS because they are real men.
sentences.zh: 我开始报道伊斯兰国，是因为他们是真正的男人。

sentences.en: I always fantasize about getting raped by them.
sentences.zh: 我总是幻想被他们强奸。

sentences.en: That's all my fantasies.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所有的幻想。

sentences.en: This is the sole reason I made multiple trips to Mosul, just to get captured by ISIS so that they can fulfill my desires.
sentences.zh: 这也是我多次前往摩苏尔的唯一原因，就是为了被伊斯兰国俘虏，好让他们满足我的愿望。

sentences.en: So I'm used to this stuff now, but back when the FBI first came, it didn't really sink in.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在对这些东西已经习惯了，但当年联邦调查局刚来的时候，并没有真正缓过神来。

sentences.en: It was so unbelievable that honestly, I just, I think I just stored it away somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 这一切太难以置信了，说实话，我当时，我想我只是把它存放在了记忆的某个角落。

sentences.en: And then weeks went by.
sentences.zh: 然后几个星期过去了。

sentences.en: There was another apparent terror attack in Europe, this time in Germany.
sentences.zh: 欧洲又发生了一起明显的恐怖袭击，这一次是在德国。

sentences.en: And months went by.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了。

sentences.en: A series of deadly bombs, at least one packed with nails, killing dozens, injuring hundreds.
sentences.zh: 一系列致命炸弹，其中至少一枚塞满了钉子，炸死数十人，炸伤数百人。

sentences.en: And in that period of time, I covered attack after attack.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，我接连报道了一场又一场袭击。

sentences.en: Two terrorists stormed the church during morning mass, taking a priest, two nuns, and two churchgoers hostage.
sentences.zh: 两名恐怖分子在早晨弥撒期间冲进教堂，劫持了一名神父、两名修女和两名教堂常客作为人质。

sentences.en: And a planned and deliberate attack in suburban Sydney.
sentences.zh: 还有悉尼郊区一起有计划、有预谋的袭击。

sentences.en: It starts to just marinate in your consciousness.
sentences.zh: 这一切开始在你的意识中发酵。

sentences.en: German media reports the attacker shouted, Allahu Akbar, as he hacked at the passengers.
sentences.zh: 德国媒体报道称，袭击者在对乘客大砍大杀时高喊“真主至大”。

sentences.en: And then about a year later, I was home alone late at night.
sentences.zh: 大约一年后，深夜我独自在家。

sentences.en: So I'm home alone, and I'm by myself because at this point in time, my husband was working the overnight at his company.
sentences.zh: 所以我独自在家，因为当时我丈夫正在公司上夜班。

sentences.en: At 12.30, I think, at night, I'm getting ready to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 我想是夜里12点半，我正准备上床睡觉。

sentences.en: I'm actually under the covers, and I'm upstairs with my two dogs.
sentences.zh: 其实我正躲在被窝里，和我的两只狗在楼上。

sentences.en: And suddenly, my Rhodesian Ridgeback, which is a big dog, starts growling.
sentences.zh: 突然，我的罗德西亚背脊犬——那是一只大狗——开始低吼。

sentences.en: The hair on his back is straight up.
sentences.zh: 它背上的毛全竖起来了。

sentences.en: Immediately afterwards, I start hearing somebody ringing the doorbell downstairs.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，我听到有人在楼下按门铃。

sentences.en: And they're ringing continuously.
sentences.zh: 而且按个不停。

sentences.en: So it's not like, it's not like knock, knock, and then go away.
sentences.zh: 所以不是那种，不是那种敲两下就走的情况。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, knock, knock, knock.
sentences.zh: 而是那种，你知道的，急促地敲门。

sentences.en: I'm thinking to myself, what is this?
sentences.zh: 我心里在想，这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, like, like, you know, who is this?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像，就像，你知道的，这是谁啊？

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么？

sentences.en: So I get a hold of my husband, who assures me that it's not him.
sentences.zh: 于是我联系了我丈夫，他向我保证绝对不是他。

sentences.en: At this point, I've turned off the lights in the second floor bedroom because I don't want the people who are outside to see where I am.
sentences.zh: 这时候，我已经关掉了二楼卧室的灯，因为我不想让外面的人看到我在哪里。

sentences.en: So the dog is barking, the knocking is going on, and the doorbell is ringing and ringing and ringing.
sentences.zh: 狗在叫，敲门声不断，门铃也一直在响个不停。

sentences.en: At this point, I'm so scared that, like, my hands are not even working.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，我吓得手都快不听使唤了。

sentences.zh: 911，您有什么紧急情况？

sentences.zh: 我不知道这算不算紧急情况。

sentences.en: So the FBI agent who had come to see me had told me that they had alerted the particular police precinct where I lived.
sentences.zh: 之前来找过我的那个FBI探员告诉我，他们已经知会了我住所辖区的警察局。

sentences.en: He said, if you ever have, you know, any issues, all you have to do is call 911.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果你遇到任何问题，你只需要拨打911。

sentences.en: They have you on a liSt.
sentences.zh: 他们有你的备案。

sentences.en: My name is Rokmini Kalimaki, and I've had direct threats against me and my family.
sentences.zh: 我叫鲁克米尼·卡利马基，我和我的家人曾收到直接的死亡威胁。

sentences.zh: 好的，所以你的意思是，FBI在对你发出威胁？

sentences.zh: 我只是看到了一个人的剪影。

sentences.zh: 我不记得那个女人具体说了什么，但大概意思是，女士，你是想告诉我ISIS在按你的门铃吗？

sentences.zh: 好吧，我会派一名警员过去跟你谈谈。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，女士。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: So she calls me back and she says, ma'am, I am calling to tell you that we've investigated, and it happens to be the water department.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿她回电话给我，说，女士，我打电话是想告诉你，我们调查过了，原来是水务局的人。

sentences.zh: 你那条街的主水管爆裂了，因此，他们正在挨家挨户通知附近居民，说你们家的马桶暂时不能冲水了。

sentences.en: What do you think the moral of that story is, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，你觉得这个故事的寓意是什么？

sentences.zh: 这个故事的寓意是什么？

sentences.en: Like, why is it that that's the story you chose to tell me when I asked you if you've ever been afraid?
sentences.zh: 为什么当我问你是否曾经感到害怕时，你偏偏要讲这个故事？

sentences.zh: 我想这个故事说明了我如何一步步陷入了ISIS企图造成的困境，因为到头来，

sentences.zh: 这些野蛮和暴力行径的目的就是为了恐吓我们。

sentences.zh: 他们试图吓唬我们，对吧？

sentences.en: They're trying to make themselves into boogeymen and live in our imagination.
sentences.zh: 他们试图把自己包装成恐怖的怪物，活在我们的想象里。

sentences.zh: 而那天晚上……

sentences.zh: 他们得逞了。

sentences.zh: 那天晚上他们确实吓到我了。

sentences.zh: 回到酒店后，我们在那里待了多久，两个小时？

sentences.zh: 我们的酒店房间门被敲响了。

sentences.zh: 我很震惊，因为我以为他会去大堂，然后由大堂给我们打电话。

sentences.en: But instead, he had managed to walk past the lobby.
sentences.zh: 但相反，他竟然自己走过了大堂。

sentences.zh: 我打开门，他穿着一件连帽衫。

sentences.zh: 连帽衫拉得太靠前了，我几乎看不清他的脸。

sentences.en: His face was in shadow.
sentences.zh: 他的脸隐在阴影里。

sentences.en: And he kept it kind of pulled down like that for some time.
sentences.zh: 而且他把帽子拉得很低，保持那个姿势好一会儿。

sentences.en: Come on in.
sentences.zh: 请进。

sentences.en: So we thought that we would...
sentences.zh: 所以我们以为我们会……

sentences.en: What did you want to sit here?
sentences.zh: 你想坐在哪里？

sentences.zh: 我记得我们俩当时都表现得非常友善。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: I was like, overtly like, hey, what is it, Dad?
sentences.zh: 我甚至表现得很刻意，比如，嘿，怎么了，老爸？

sentences.en: You know, like, can I get you some tea?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如，要不要给你倒杯茶？

sentences.en: No, that's not fun.
sentences.zh: 不，这样就没意思了。

sentences.en: No?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: This water is great.
sentences.zh: 这水很好喝。

sentences.en: We have water.
sentences.zh: 我们有水。

sentences.en: And then we sat down and started talking.
sentences.zh: 然后我们坐下来开始交谈。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So first of all, thank you so much for coming.
